{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Tailored blazer, single-breasted, hip length, slightly structured shoulder, medium grey #8A8D91, wool-blend suiting with a fine texture

Tailored straight-leg trousers, full length to the ankle bone, matching grey #8A8D91, wool-blend suiting (same fabric as the blazer)

Fitted blouse, classic collar, long sleeves, hip-skimming tuck-in length, soft ivory #F2EDE4, matte crepe

Loafers, almond toe, low block heel, ankle-skimming cut, deep charcoal #3B3E42, smooth leather

Belt, slim, tonal with the shoes, charcoal #3B3E42, smooth leather with a brushed silver buckle

Earrings, drop style, slender and slightly sculptural, polished silver #C0C0C0, sterling silver

Structured tote, medium size, clean lines, black-charcoal #2B2D30, grained leather

Because the grey suit was her wish, the blazer and trousers are cut from one fabric and form a proper business suit, which fits a neat office day in autumn. The ivory blouse softens the grey and keeps the look warm and fresh without competing with the suit. The charcoal loafers and belt deepen the palette in a calm, tonal way and keep the outfit comfortable for a full workday. The silver drop earrings give the accent in jewelry she asked for, standing out cleanly against the quiet neutrals."}
